title: Scenario 3: Ambiguous (Enterprise Abuse & Security Hardening)
raw_prompt: Make our URL shortener service enterprise-ready and safe against abuse.
user_stories: As an API consumer, I want to make our url shortener service enterprise-ready and safe against abuse so that the system reliably fulfills the request with low latency.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid inputs, When the API is invoked, Then the response status must be 200/201 and match schema.
Given invalid or malicious inputs, When the API is invoked, Then the request must be safely rejected with appropriate error code.
Given high concurrency, When requests are executed, Then latency P99 must remain < 50ms without data corruption.
Criterion 1: Enforce sliding-window rate limit (100 req/min per IP).
Criterion 2: Enforce SSRF blocklist on internal IP ranges.
assumptions: Enforce sliding-window rate limit (100 req/min per IP).
Enforce SSRF blocklist on internal IP ranges.
